metric_definitions.total_scenarios_executed: Total individual test executions performed across all benchmark iterations.
metric_definitions.original_test_failures_caused_by_ui_chan: Cases where the original locator broke due to UI layout/identifier changes (changed IDs, renamed buttons, rearranged fields, accessible labels, layout redesign).
metric_definitions.successful_recoveries: Cases where TestPhoenix reconstructed the workflow, safely executed the replacement, and verified outcome across UI and SQLite backend.
metric_definitions.failed_recoveries: Cases where a UI change was present but recovery could not be completed safely or postcondition failed.
metric_definitions.incorrect_recovery_attempts: False positive recovery attempts on genuine application defects (e.g. attempting to self-heal a 500 error or disabled control). Target: 0.
metric_definitions.human_review_cases: Cases where candidate similarity was ambiguous (score margin < 0.15 threshold) and execution was safely halted for human review.
